articles.title: India-UAE CEPA Bilateral Non-Oil Trade Surpasses Targets with Preferential Tariff Utilization
articles.source: DGFT Trade Intelligence / Ministry of Commerce
articles.summary: Exporters of textiles, apparel, agricultural goods, and gems & jewellery utilize preferential duty benefits under India-UAE CEPA. Certificate of Origin issuance streamlined on DGFT electronic portal.
articles.risk_impact: Positive: Zero or reduced import tariffs for eligible Indian goods into UAE ports.

articles.title: Jebel Ali Port Operations and DP World Container Flow Stable with Standard Clearance Windows
articles.summary: Maritime freight between western Indian ports (Nhava Sheva, Mundra) and Jebel Ali (Dubai) operating on normal 3 to 5 day transit schedules. No significant congestions reported.
articles.risk_impact: Low shipping risk: Predictable delivery timelines for sea cargo.

articles.title: UAE Central Bank Monitors Regional FX Liquidity; USD/AED Peg Remains Solid at 3.6725
articles.summary: The UAE Dirham remains steadfastly pegged to the US Dollar, maintaining predictable cross-rates for INR-AED settlements.
articles.risk_impact: Low currency risk for AED peg, though INR fluctuations should be buffered with 1.5% to 3.0% margin.
